如果您想了解 Krea2 8 步电影肖像基准工作流程在实践中的工作原理，请先观看完整视频。该视频展示了轻量级 Krea2 Turbo 管道如何通过简单的结构、快速采样和经过调整的调节再平衡设置生成精美的肖像风格图像。

此 ComfyUI 工作流程被设计为用于电影肖像和风格化图像生成的干净 Krea2 Turbo 基准。其目的不是成为一个大型的多阶段制作图，而是提供一个快速、稳定且可重复的基线，创作者可以用它来测试 Krea2 图像质量、即时响应、构图、灯光和电影风格控制。

工作流程围绕 krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors 构建，作为主要图像生成模型。文本编码器路线使用带有 Krea2 CLIP 类型的 qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors，为工作流程提供紧凑但高效的文本调节设置。 VAE 路线使用 qwen_image_vae.safetensors 进行最终图像解码。这使得图变得轻量且直接，适合快速测试和RunningHub在线使用。

此工作流程中的关键控制模块是 ConditioningKrea2Rebalance。该工作流程使用乘数为 2.5 的自定义每层权重设置。该重新平衡节点用于加强正向调节并改善模型对电影提示结构、视觉层次、主题放置、灯光和风格描述的响应。这是此工作流程比普通 Krea2 Turbo 渲染更受控制的主要原因之一。

采样部分故意简单。它使用 KSampler，具有 8 个步骤、CFG 1、欧拉采样器、简单调度程序和完全降噪。这使得工作流程足够快以进行实际迭代，同时仍然保持足够的质量以进行电影视觉测试。固定种子还可以更轻松地比较不同运行中的提示、重新平衡设置、模型行为和分辨率更改。

分辨率部分使用 FluxResolutionNode 提供灵活的宽高比和尺寸控制。在上传的设置中，工作流程已准备好进行高影响力的构图测试，包括超宽电影取景。这对于想要测试海报式肖像、奇幻人物镜头、电影封面、关键视觉效果、缩略图和风格化 AI 图像概念的创作者来说非常有用。

负调节路线使用 ConditioningZeroOut，保持工作流程干净并接近正提示驱动的 Krea2 测试结构。这就使得提示变得更加重要：主题描述、灯光、场景设计、氛围、镜头语言、风格方向都要写清楚。

输出部分很简单：KSampler 生成潜在图像，VAEDecode 将其转换为最终图像，PreviewImage 允许快速检查，SaveImage 使用 Krea2 基准样式前缀存储结果。

主要特点：

  • Krea2 Turbo 图像生成工作流程

  • 8步快速电影基准测试

  • krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors 支持

  • qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors 文本编码器

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • ConditioningKrea2Rebalance 质量控制

  • 自定义每层重新平衡权重

  • 乘数 2.5 设置

  • 8 步骤 / CFG 1 / 欧拉 / 简单

  • 用于可重复基准测试的固定种子

  • 专注于积极提示的一代

  • FluxResolutionNode大小和比例控制

  • VAEDecode 最终图像解码

  • 预览图像检查

  • 保存图像输出

  • 适用于电影肖像、奇幻人物、海报、缩略图和视觉基准测试

建议的工作流程：

从清晰的电影提示开始。首先描述主题，然后添加环境、灯光、相机取景、氛围和风格方向。保持结构集中，避免提示过多不相关的视觉想法。使用固定种子来比较相同条件下的即时变化。如果图像感觉太弱或太平淡，请先加强灯光和构图语言。如果图像变得太强烈或过度风格化，请在更改模型设置之前简化提示。在进入更繁重的 Krea2 细化、图像编辑、高分辨率升级或多阶段工作流程之前，此工作流程最好用作快速基线。

Watch the full video first if you want to understand how this Krea2 8-step cinematic portrait benchmark workflow works in practice. The video shows how a lightweight Krea2 Turbo pipeline can generate polished portrait-style images with a simple structure, fast sampling, and a tuned conditioning rebalance setup.

This ComfyUI workflow is designed as a clean Krea2 Turbo benchmark for cinematic portrait and stylized image generation. Its purpose is not to be a large multi-stage production graph, but to provide a fast, stable, and repeatable baseline that creators can use to test Krea2 image quality, prompt response, composition, lighting, and cinematic style control.

The workflow is built around krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors as the main image generation model. The text encoder route uses qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors with the Krea2 CLIP type, giving the workflow a compact but efficient text-conditioning setup. The VAE route uses qwen_image_vae.safetensors for final image decoding. This makes the graph lightweight and direct, suitable for quick testing and RunningHub online use.

The key control module in this workflow is ConditioningKrea2Rebalance. The workflow uses a custom per-layer weight setup with a multiplier of 2.5. This rebalance node is used to strengthen the positive conditioning and improve the model’s response to cinematic prompt structure, visual hierarchy, subject placement, lighting, and style description. It is one of the main reasons this workflow can feel more controlled than a plain Krea2 Turbo render.

The sampling section is intentionally simple. It uses KSampler with 8 steps, CFG 1, euler sampler, simple scheduler, and full denoise. This makes the workflow fast enough for practical iteration while still keeping enough quality for cinematic visual tests. The fixed seed also makes it easier to compare prompts, rebalance settings, model behavior, and resolution changes across different runs.

The resolution section uses FluxResolutionNode to provide flexible aspect-ratio and size control. In the uploaded setup, the workflow is prepared for high-impact composition testing, including ultra-wide cinematic framing. This is useful for creators who want to test poster-like portraits, fantasy character shots, cinematic covers, key visuals, thumbnail art, and stylized AI image concepts.

The negative conditioning route uses ConditioningZeroOut, keeping the workflow clean and close to a positive-prompt-driven Krea2 test structure. This makes the prompt more important: subject description, lighting, scene design, atmosphere, camera language, and style direction should be written clearly.

The output section is straightforward: KSampler generates the latent, VAEDecode converts it into the final image, PreviewImage allows quick inspection, and SaveImage stores the result with a Krea2 benchmark-style prefix.

Main features:

  • Krea2 Turbo image generation workflow

  • 8-step fast cinematic benchmark

  • krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors support

  • qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors text encoder

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • ConditioningKrea2Rebalance quality control

  • Custom per-layer rebalance weights

  • Multiplier 2.5 setup

  • 8 steps / CFG 1 / euler / simple

  • Fixed seed for repeatable benchmark testing

  • Positive-prompt-focused generation

  • FluxResolutionNode size and ratio control

  • VAEDecode final image decoding

  • PreviewImage inspection

  • SaveImage output

  • Suitable for cinematic portraits, fantasy characters, posters, thumbnails, and visual benchmark testing

Suggested workflow:

Start with a clear cinematic prompt. Describe the subject first, then add environment, lighting, camera framing, atmosphere, and style direction. Keep the structure focused and avoid overloading the prompt with too many unrelated visual ideas. Use the fixed seed to compare prompt changes under the same conditions. If the image feels too weak or flat, strengthen the lighting and composition language first. If the image becomes too intense or over-stylized, simplify the prompt before changing the model settings. This workflow is best used as a fast baseline before moving into heavier Krea2 refinement, image editing, high-resolution upscaling, or multi-stage workflows.
